description.subtitle: Puma Spanish La Liga Soccer Ball 2025 2026 Size 5 - White
description.tagline: Lleva el ritmo de La Liga a cada jugada
description.intro: This size 5 Puma Orbita ball replicates the style and visual strength of the official La Liga 25/26 ball. Ideal for players over 12 years old who look for performance, design and authenticity in every training or match.
key_benefits: Official design of La Liga 25/26: Inspired by the ball used in the competition matches.
Regulation competition size: Perfect for training and matches at youth and adult level.
Buena durabilidad y respuesta: Materiales resistentes y estructura pensada para el uso constante.
Great control and precision: Optimized design for stable trajectories and reliable feel.
Accessible professional aesthetics: Ideal for those who want to train with the look of professional football.
